datasets.MVTec: get_text_and_image_dataset('MVTec', img_size, stage='test'); up to 2 normal + 2 anomaly per class by SHA256 ordering
datasets.VisA: existing deterministic 48-image audit manifest and deterministic test preprocessing

decision_rules.dataset_status: inconclusive if stage or ranking-error dynamic range is absent; supported requires both co-primary signals to show coherent association, above-random damage capture, multi-class direction, aligned-vs-shifted control, score-matched residual, and oracle gain over confidence; weak if only simple co-primary support; otherwise null

frozen_formulas.D_jack: population std across leave-one-stage-out consensus percentile ranks; diagnostic only
frozen_formulas.D_logit: population std across groups of native margins
frozen_formulas.D_rank: population std across groups of within-image average-tie percentile ranks
frozen_formulas.R_neg: fraction anomaly scores strictly lower plus half tied fraction
frozen_formulas.R_pos: fraction normal scores strictly greater plus half tied fraction

loader.precision: strict FP32; TF32 off; AMP off

metric_reference.tie_semantics: equal-score groups together; AUROC ties receive 0.5 pair credit

predictor_semantics.deployment: Industrial Gaussian blur kernel=7 sigma=1; bilinear align_corners=True; mean group logits; softmax class dimension
